response:
I’d block 11 findings, warn on 24, and ignore 7. I’m treating `agent_risk` as prioritization—not a substitute for impact: concrete correctness, portability, contract, and clean-install failures can block even when their graph-derived risk is low.

## Block merge

| ID | Finding | Severity / agent risk | Rationale |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 00001 | `direct_date` — `src/date.ts` | high / 0.44 | Highest-risk finding in the scan. Eight uncontrolled clock reads make time-sensitive behavior nondeterministic. |
| 00009 | `mixed_utc_local_methods` | high / 0.36 | Concrete timezone correctness defect: one value is interpreted in incompatible time domains. |
| 00011 | `timezone_unsafe_parse` | medium / 0.35 | Ambiguous date strings can represent different instants across hosts; should be resolved before shipping. |
| 00015 | `hardcoded_localhost` | medium / 0.30 | Production source is tied to a developer server and will fail outside that environment. |
| 00016 | `hardcoded_local_path` | medium / 0.30 | The `/Users/andrew/...` path makes the new repository non-portable for CI, deployment, and other developers. |
| 00017 | `dst_naive_arithmetic` | medium / 0.30 | Adding 86,400,000 ms is observably wrong for calendar-day operations across DST boundaries. |
| 00019 | `logic_in_comments` | medium / 0.30 | The comment describes an authorization/business rule—owners, enterprise refunds, support approval—that nearby code apparently does not enforce. Confirm or encode it before merging. |
| 00032 | `contract_drift` — `User` | high / 0.22 | Despite the modest aggregate risk, two same-named contracts disagree on a timestamp field. This is a concrete API/data-contract ambiguity. |
| 00033 | `contract_drift` — `Invoice` | high / 0.22 | Six disagreements include money, identifier, and timestamp fields. This is the strongest contract-integrity blocker. |
| 00040 | `swallowed_error` | low / 0.12 | Severity and risk understate the concrete behavior: invoice email failure is discarded and the caller sees success. |
| 00041 | `dependency_provenance_gap` | low / 0.12 | `vitest` is undeclared, so a clean install/test run can fail. A new repository should be reproducible from its manifest. |

## Warn

| ID | Finding | Severity / agent risk | Rationale |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 00002 | `return_shape_roulette` | low / 0.43 | Very high agent risk for a low finding; explicitly type the three incompatible result variants soon. |
| 00003 | `missing_agent_context` | medium / 0.42 | The shipped CLI lacks agent-readable commands and safety guidance. Important for maintenance, but not a runtime defect. |
| 00004 | `magic_domain_literal_scatter` | medium / 0.42 | `"enterprise"` spans four areas and may become duplicated policy; centralize or document its authority. |
| 00005 | `duplicated_navigation_source` | medium / 0.38 | Conflicting “Plans”/“Billing” labels indicate multiple nav authorities, but canonical wording needs product input. |
| 00006 | `route_metadata_drift` | medium / 0.38 | Four competing names create user and maintenance inconsistency; align after choosing the intended terminology. |
| 00007 | `sync_io_in_hotpath` | low / 0.38 | Blocking I/O has substantial agent risk, but whether this function is truly latency-sensitive needs call-site confirmation. |
| 00008 | `option_bag_junk_drawer` | low / 0.38 | Six implicitly shaped options make future edits error-prone; type it, but it is not demonstrated broken behavior. |
| 00010 | `negative_flag_maze` | low / 0.36 | Meaningful readability risk, especially combined with implicit options, but the condition is still small. |
| 00012 | `direct_date` — `src/billing.ts` | medium / 0.34 | Seven wall-clock reads deserve a clock boundary, though existing tests reduce the immediate score. |
| 00013 | `name_behavior_mismatch` | medium / 0.31 | A “preview” function sends email and writes audit data. Rename or separate effects before callers assume purity. |
| 00014 | `large_function` | high / 0.30 | A 204-line invoice function is hazardous to modify, but size alone is not evidence of incorrect behavior. |
| 00018 | `concept_alias_drift` | medium / 0.30 | Account/organisation/team/workspace may be genuine distinctions; require a vocabulary decision before renaming. |
| 00020 | `todo_density` — `src/todo.ts` | medium / 0.30 | Fourteen markers make intended behavior unclear. Triage them, but comments alone should not gate the merge. |
| 00021 | `commented_out_code` | medium / 0.29 | Stale refund code can mislead maintainers; delete it, though it does not execute. |
| 00023 | `direct_date` — `src/api/state.ts` | low / 0.28 | One clock read is localized; cover it with an injectable clock when this state logic is touched. |
| 00024 | `singular_plural_type_mismatch` | low / 0.28 | `users: User` and `invoice: Invoice[]` can cause caller mistakes; confirm whether these are intentional fixtures. |
| 00025 | `weak_test_signal` — no assertions | medium / 0.27 | The test provides false confidence. Add an observable assertion, but this alone does not prove production behavior is wrong. |
| 00026 | `date_string_concat` | low / 0.26 | Manual formatting risks zero-indexed months and missing padding; consolidate with the other date fixes. |
| 00027 | `locale_drift` | low / 0.26 | Host-dependent output can make UI/tests vary, but the intended locale must first be established. |
| 00030 | `docs_code_drift` | low / 0.24 | The broken `setup.md` link is concrete and easy to fix, without affecting runtime behavior. |
| 00031 | `weak_test_signal` — weak matcher | low / 0.23 | Strengthen the assertion, but a weak matcher is not necessarily a no-op test. |
| 00034 | `orphaned_destination` — account | low / 0.22 | Confirm whether the route is intentionally deep-linked or unfinished before wiring up or deleting it. |
| 00035 | `orphaned_destination` — team | low / 0.22 | Same: likely IA debt, but reachability intent is not established by the scan. |
| 00036 | `orphaned_destination` — workspace | low / 0.22 | Same: investigate intended entry points rather than deleting automatically. |

## Ignore

| ID | Finding | Severity / agent risk | Rationale |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 00022 | `boolean_naming_drift` — state | low / 0.29 | `paid`, `expired`, and `stale` are conventional predicate names; this is stylistic rather than meaningful change risk. |
| 00028 | `boolean_naming_drift` — flags | low / 0.26 | `disableBilling` and `skipRetry` already read as boolean actions; likely detector noise. |
| 00029 | `svg_with_embedded_raster` | high / 0.24 | The headline severity is disproportionate to a 592-byte asset. No material performance or merge risk is demonstrated. |
| 00037 | `large_file` | medium / 0.18 | The file is only ten lines over the threshold; the genuinely risky 204-line function is already reported separately. |
| 00038 | `raster_should_be_vector` | low / 0.16 | A 32×32 PNG may be a deliberate asset choice; no measured size or rendering problem is shown. |
| 00039 | `oversized_raster` | low / 0.14 | A 254 KB hero image is optimization debt, not a blocker without a stated page-weight budget or rendered dimensions. |
| 00042 | `todo_density` — `src/billing.ts` | low / 0.08 | Barely exceeds the density threshold and has the lowest risk score; track during normal cleanup. |

The most important remediation cluster is `src/date.ts`, followed by environment portability in `src/api/files.ts`, then unifying the `User` and `Invoice` contracts. After those blockers, `src/billing.ts` deserves a focused follow-up rather than a broad pre-merge rewrite.
